question: Find the part of the sentence containing an error: The witness declined to speak (1)/ until the inquiry had concluded (2)/ to prevent affecting (3)/ the legal process (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "**to prevent affecting**" in part 3 of the sentence.
 
• The phrase "to prevent affecting" is grammatically incorrect and awkward in construction.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**to prevent any effect on**" to ensure proper grammar and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The witness declined to speak until the inquiry had concluded to prevent any effect on the legal process."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1:** "The witness declined to speak" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2:** "until the inquiry had concluded" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4:** "the legal process" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
